SUCCESS: goal entry AND no confirmed geometric overlap AND no footprint outside corridor
SAFETY_FAILURE: confirmed geometric overlap OR footprint outside corridor (existing SE2 arcs, axis extrema checked)
MARGIN_VIOLATION: Separate sum of positive-duration 72Hz intervals with any obstacle swept lower bound <.02m; no change to SUCCESS/SAFETY_FAILURE
label: PHASE4D_CONFIRM
seed_rule: 101 + 10000*index + 2*request_id; DDPM seed +1; same index offset for every alpha/method
matrix: Index 4..8, then alpha inf/2.0, then CURV/GRAPH. Serial; no retries; no CURV+ACC. Reuse Phase4c indices1..3 including its v5-pilot CURV infinity references.
execution: Import Phase4c AccelExecution, AngularPlant and control_command unchanged. Stage2 v4 worker, weights, acceptance and .5s stale unchanged. 4/9/72Hz, waypoint timeout1s; nominal NoMaD scaling unchanged.

statistics.pairing: Only technical-PASS, jointly successful GRAPH/CURV (alpha,index) pairs. No timeout/failed goal-time imputation.
statistics.resampling: Within alpha: paired index. Pooled: seed-index clusters; keep all eligible alpha pairs for each sampled index together. Statistic is median of pairwise GRAPH-CURV goal times, pooled across alpha. Not difference of marginal medians.
statistics.no_pairs: Median and CI are null; speed claim false. Report eligible pair and independent seed-index counts.
statistics.fisher: scipy.stats.fisher_exact two-sided; success/non-success among technically valid runs; pooled is descriptive and does not model shared seed dependence.
statistics.technical_failures: Separate count, never classified as navigation collision/timeout or assigned goal time. Reliability is literal observed success-count comparison; separately flag incomplete technical evidence.

decision.speed: Jointly successful paired goal-time difference median <0 AND paired bootstrap 95% upper bound <0
decision.overall: Pooled criteria: both true CONFIRMED; one true PARTIAL; neither true NOT_CONFIRMED. Technical evidence completeness reported separately.

scope: Oracle geometry; SE(2) kinematic Isaac Sim; N8 per alpha/method; reuse prior3 plus new5. Paired seeds do not imply identical closed-loop RGB or predictions.
preparation: No navigation or inference by Codex. Freeze code/protocol before user execution. Report is a separate command; no new figures.
git_state: Tracked code clean; preserve and hash preexisting untracked research/results/phase4_pilot/ as in Phase4c.
